examples.en: The poor peasant worked hard in the rice fields all day.
examples.zh: 那个贫穷的农夫整天在稻田里辛苦劳作。

examples.en: They took a relaxing cruise around the beautiful islands.
examples.zh: 他们乘船在美丽的群岛周围悠闲地巡游了一番。

examples.en: I buy fresh fruit and milk at the supermarket every week.
examples.zh: 我每周都在超市买新鲜水果和牛奶。

examples.en: Her bedroom is always clean and neat.
examples.zh: 她的卧室总是干净整洁。

examples.en: This building was formerly a small village school.
examples.zh: 这座建筑以前是一所乡村小学。

examples.en: The lawmaker voted to pass the new safety law.
examples.zh: 这位立法者投票通过了新的安全法。

examples.en: A mobile library brings books to many small towns.
examples.zh: 一座流动图书馆把书籍送到许多小镇。

examples.en: I marked my friend's birthday on the calendar.
examples.zh: 我在日历上标记了朋友的生日。

examples.en: The old man had a long white beard.
examples.zh: 那位老人留着长长的白胡须。

examples.en: The widow lives alone since her husband died.
examples.zh: 自从丈夫去世后，这位寡妇就独自生活。

examples.en: She put a deposit in the bank every month.
examples.zh: 她每个月都往银行存一笔存款。

examples.en: He pressed the brake to stop the car quickly.
examples.zh: 他踩下刹车让汽车迅速停下。

examples.en: On a sudden impulse, she bought the red dress.
examples.zh: 一时冲动之下，她买下了那条红裙子。

examples.en: The soldiers were known for their brutal treatment of prisoners.
examples.zh: 这些士兵以残忍地对待囚犯而闻名。

examples.en: The teacher will forbid students from using phones in class.
examples.zh: 老师会禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

examples.en: The lion is a powerful predator on the grassland.
examples.zh: 狮子是草原上强大的食肉动物。

examples.en: The rabbit has soft white fur.
examples.zh: 这只兔子有着柔软的白色毛皮。

examples.en: Joining the club is completely voluntary.
examples.zh: 加入这个俱乐部完全是自愿的。

examples.en: Please don't poke me with your pencil.
examples.zh: 请别用铅笔戳我。

examples.en: Your ticket is still valid for one more day.
examples.zh: 你的票还有一天有效。

examples.en: Many students opt to study abroad after college.
examples.zh: 许多学生选择大学毕业后出国留学。

examples.en: The school held a forum to discuss the new rules.
examples.zh: 学校举办了一场论坛来讨论新规定。

examples.en: We watched the eagle soar high above the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们看着老鹰高高地翱翔在群山之上。

examples.en: The children played happily in the park all afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里快乐地玩耍。

examples.en: The actors will enact the famous battle scene tonight.
examples.zh: 演员们今晚将表演那个著名的战斗场景。

examples.en: The removal of the old tree took several hours.
examples.zh: 移除那棵老树花了好几个小时。

examples.en: The region was given more autonomy to govern itself.
examples.zh: 这个地区获得了更多的自治权来管理自己。

examples.en: The old tower is a famous landmark in the city.
examples.zh: 这座古塔是城市里著名的地标。

examples.en: She felt unhappy after losing the game.
examples.zh: 输掉比赛后她感到很不开心。

examples.en: He told me privately that he wanted to leave.
examples.zh: 他私下告诉我他想离开。

examples.en: Only a small fraction of the students passed the exam.
examples.zh: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。

examples.en: Tourism brings a lot of money to the island.
examples.zh: 旅游业为这座岛屿带来了大量收入。

examples.en: The young offender was sent to a special school.
examples.zh: 这个年轻的罪犯被送进了一所特殊学校。

examples.en: The bird has a distinctive red mark on its head.
examples.zh: 这只鸟头上有一个独特的红色标记。

examples.en: Graduation is the threshold of a new life.
examples.zh: 毕业是新生活的开端。

examples.en: They booked a large suite at the hotel.
examples.zh: 他们在酒店预订了一间宽敞的套房。

examples.en: The nurse routinely checks the patients every morning.
examples.zh: 护士每天早上例行检查病人。

examples.en: The regulator controls the flow of gas in the pipe.
examples.zh: 这个调节器控制着管道中气体的流量。

examples.en: The farmer used straw to feed the cows.
examples.zh: 农夫用稻草喂牛。

examples.en: He is studying a difficult theological question.
examples.zh: 他正在研究一个困难的神学问题。

examples.en: Please be careful, this glass cup is very fragile.
examples.zh: 请小心，这个玻璃杯非常易碎。

examples.en: Black exhaust came out of the old truck.
examples.zh: 黑色的废气从那辆旧卡车里冒出来。

examples.en: The teacher pointed to China on the globe.
examples.zh: 老师在地球仪上指出了中国的位置。

examples.en: We learned about water and acids in chemistry class.
examples.zh: 我们在化学课上学习了水和酸。

examples.en: Nobody raised any objection to the new plan.
examples.zh: 没有人对新计划提出任何异议。

examples.en: The blast from the explosion broke many windows.
examples.zh: 爆炸产生的冲击波震碎了许多窗户。

examples.en: In the end, good will prevail over evil.
examples.zh: 最终，正义将战胜邪恶。

examples.en: We stayed overnight at a small hotel near the lake.
examples.zh: 我们在湖边一家小旅馆过了一夜。

examples.en: His denial of the mistake made everyone angry.
examples.zh: 他对错误的否认让大家都很生气。

examples.en: She found a fragment of a broken plate on the floor.
examples.zh: 她在地板上发现了一块破盘子的碎片。

examples.en: I have a bad headache and need to rest.
examples.zh: 我头痛得厉害，需要休息一下。

examples.en: The monthly rental for the small flat is quite low.
examples.zh: 这套小公寓的月租金相当低。

examples.en: We had a fantastic time at the beach yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们在海滩度过了一段美妙的时光。

examples.en: We enjoyed the warmth of the fire on a cold night.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚，我们享受着炉火的温暖。

examples.en: He used a screw to fix the broken chair.
examples.zh: 他用一颗螺丝钉修好了坏掉的椅子。

examples.en: She is an undergraduate student studying history.
examples.zh: 她是一名学习历史的本科生。

examples.en: The policeman helped the lost child find her mother.
examples.zh: 那位警察帮助迷路的孩子找到了妈妈。

examples.en: The projection shows that sales will rise next year.
examples.zh: 这项预测显示明年销售额将会上升。

examples.en: This movie is not suitable for young children.
examples.zh: 这部电影不适合年幼的孩子观看。

examples.en: Her parents were proud at her graduation.
examples.zh: 在她毕业典礼上，她的父母感到很骄傲。

examples.en: He used a drill to make holes in the wall.
examples.zh: 他用钻孔机在墙上打孔。

examples.en: The rich family lives in a huge mansion.
examples.zh: 这个富裕的家庭住在一座巨大的宅邸里。

examples.en: It is cruel to leave a dog outside in the cold.
examples.zh: 把狗留在外面挨冻是很残忍的。

examples.en: The book discusses gender and sexuality openly.
examples.zh: 这本书公开讨论了性别与性。

examples.en: These sweet grapes come from a nearby farm.
examples.zh: 这些甜葡萄来自附近的一个农场。

examples.en: They spent the summer in a small cottage by the sea.
examples.zh: 他们在海边的一间小屋里度过了夏天。

examples.en: Only the manager can authorize such a large payment.
examples.zh: 只有经理才能批准这么大的一笔付款。

examples.en: The river runs through a deep canyon.
examples.zh: 这条河流穿过一个很深的峡谷。

examples.en: She wore a small charm to bring good luck.
examples.zh: 她戴着一个小符咒来求好运。

examples.en: He parked the car in the driveway.
examples.zh: 他把车停在了私人车道上。

examples.en: A dog is a loyal friend to its owner.
examples.zh: 狗是对主人忠诚的朋友。

examples.en: The children made small animals out of clay.
examples.zh: 孩子们用黏土做了一些小动物。

examples.en: The telephone was a very important invention.
examples.zh: 电话是一项非常重要的发明。

examples.en: The little boy held a red balloon at the party.
examples.zh: 小男孩在派对上拿着一个红气球。

examples.en: His big ego makes it hard for him to admit mistakes.
examples.zh: 他自我膨胀的心态让他很难承认错误。

examples.en: The bus fare went up by one dollar this year.
examples.zh: 今年公交车费涨了一美元。

examples.en: Please check the availability of rooms before you book.
examples.zh: 预订前请先确认是否有空房。

examples.en: I must finish my math homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 我必须在晚饭前完成数学作业。

examples.en: She put an old music disc into the player.
examples.zh: 她把一张旧唱片放进了播放器。

examples.en: The ship uses radar to find other boats in the fog.
examples.zh: 这艘船用雷达在雾中寻找其他船只。

examples.en: The young prince lived in a grand castle.
examples.zh: 年轻的王子住在一座宏伟的城堡里。

examples.en: We sat on the soft sofa to watch a movie.
examples.zh: 我们坐在柔软的沙发上看电影。

examples.en: She slowly began to regain her strength after the illness.
examples.zh: 生病后她慢慢开始恢复了体力。

examples.en: A worried frown appeared on his face.
examples.zh: 他脸上露出了担忧的皱眉。

examples.en: A water molecule is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 一个水分子由氢和氧构成。

examples.en: The army began a slow retreat from the city.
examples.zh: 军队开始缓慢地从城市撤退。

examples.en: She wore a warm wool sweater in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天她穿着一件暖和的羊毛毛衣。

examples.en: The weather was favorable for our trip to the beach.
examples.zh: 去海滩的天气对我们的旅行很有利。

examples.en: Car tires are made of strong rubber.
examples.zh: 汽车轮胎是用坚固的橡胶制成的。

examples.en: Children can play freely in this large park.
examples.zh: 孩子们可以在这个大公园里自由玩耍。

examples.en: After the accident, he needed months of rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 事故之后，他需要几个月的康复治疗。

examples.en: The number of visitors grew steadily each year.
examples.zh: 游客的数量每年都在稳步增长。

examples.en: The youngster dreamed of becoming a pilot.
examples.zh: 这个年轻人梦想成为一名飞行员。

examples.en: Ha! I knew you would say that.
examples.zh: 哈！我就知道你会这么说。

examples.en: Teachers must have accountability for their students' safety.
examples.zh: 老师必须对学生的安全负有责任。

examples.en: She pays a small premium for her car insurance each month.
examples.zh: 她每月为汽车保险支付一小笔保险费。

examples.en: He sat quietly to contemplate his future.
examples.zh: 他静静地坐着，沉思自己的未来。

examples.en: She gave us an update on the project this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上她向我们通报了项目的最新进展。

examples.en: So many messages can overwhelm a busy worker.
examples.zh: 这么多的信息会让忙碌的员工不知所措。

examples.en: A small spark from the wire started the fire.
examples.zh: 电线上的一点小火花引发了火灾。

examples.en: After the long hike, she felt great fatigue.
examples.zh: 长途徒步之后，她感到非常疲劳。

examples.en: Ironically, the fire station itself caught fire.
examples.zh: 讽刺的是，消防站自己着火了。

examples.en: People speculate about who will win the election.
examples.zh: 人们都在推测谁会赢得选举。

examples.en: A small stone marker shows where the path begins.
examples.zh: 一块小石头标记着小路的起点。

examples.en: She filled the bucket with clean water.
examples.zh: 她往桶里装满了干净的水。

examples.en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, let's set the table.
examples.zh: 晚饭正在做，与此同时，我们来摆桌子吧。

examples.en: The priest will preach to the people on Sunday.
examples.zh: 牧师将在星期天向人们布道。

examples.en: Prices have risen substantially over the past year.
examples.zh: 过去一年里物价大幅上涨。

examples.en: The little girl has long blond hair.
examples.zh: 这个小女孩有一头长长的金发。

examples.en: His confession surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他的坦白让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

examples.en: The floor of the palace was made of white marble.
examples.zh: 宫殿的地板是用白色大理石铺成的。

examples.en: He became a strong defender of the poor.
examples.zh: 他成了穷人坚定的辩护者。

examples.en: Try not to provoke the angry dog.
examples.zh: 尽量别去激怒那只发怒的狗。

examples.en: The accident left her with deep emotional trauma.
examples.zh: 那场事故给她留下了深深的情感创伤。

examples.en: The police kept the building under close surveillance.
examples.zh: 警方对这栋大楼进行了严密的监视。

examples.en: The teacher gave us explicit instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 老师给了我们清楚明确的考试说明。

examples.en: The train will depart from platform two at noon.
examples.zh: 火车将在中午从二号站台出发。

examples.en: The needle points north because of magnetic force.
examples.zh: 由于磁力的作用，指针指向北方。

examples.en: The technician came to fix our broken computer.
examples.zh: 技术员来修理我们坏掉的电脑。

examples.en: Follow the arrow to find the exit.
examples.zh: 顺着箭头就能找到出口。

examples.en: Soak the beans in water overnight before cooking.
examples.zh: 煮之前把豆子在水里泡一整夜。

examples.en: The station can transmit news around the world.
examples.zh: 这个电台能把新闻传播到世界各地。

examples.en: I heard a low mutter coming from the next room.
examples.zh: 我听到隔壁房间传来低低的嘀咕声。

examples.en: She tied a pretty ribbon around the gift box.
examples.zh: 她在礼物盒上系了一条漂亮的缎带。

examples.en: The farmers had a good harvest this autumn.
examples.zh: 今年秋天农民们获得了好收成。

examples.en: Put the coin into the slot to buy a drink.
examples.zh: 把硬币投进投币口就能买饮料。

examples.en: It rained for five consecutive days last week.
examples.zh: 上周连续下了五天的雨。

examples.en: The spy secretly sent messages to another country.
examples.zh: 这名间谍秘密地向另一个国家传递情报。

examples.en: Each point on the map has a coordinate.
examples.zh: 地图上的每个点都有一个坐标。

examples.en: The little girl ran to hug her daddy.
examples.zh: 小女孩跑过去拥抱她的爸爸。

examples.en: A riot broke out in the city after the news.
examples.zh: 消息传出后，城市里爆发了一场暴动。

examples.en: Vegetables give your body important nutrients.
examples.zh: 蔬菜为你的身体提供重要的营养物。

examples.en: He was severely injured in the car accident.
examples.zh: 他在车祸中受了重伤。

examples.en: After many years, she finally gained citizenship.
examples.zh: 经过许多年，她终于获得了公民身份。

examples.en: The small country fought hard to keep its sovereignty.
examples.zh: 这个小国为保住自己的主权而努力抗争。

examples.en: We hiked along the mountain ridge for hours.
examples.zh: 我们沿着山脊徒步走了好几个小时。

examples.en: Bad weather can frustrate our travel plans.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气会打乱我们的旅行计划。

examples.en: She is a regular contributor to the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 她是校报的固定投稿人。

examples.en: More importantly, we must keep everyone safe.
examples.zh: 更重要的是，我们必须保证每个人的安全。

examples.en: The goods were damaged in transit to the store.
examples.zh: 货物在运往商店的途中被损坏了。

examples.en: Please specify the time and place of the meeting.
examples.zh: 请明确说明会议的时间和地点。

examples.en: An unidentified object appeared in the night sky.
examples.zh: 一个不明物体出现在夜空中。

examples.en: We attended a seminar on healthy eating.
examples.zh: 我们参加了一场关于健康饮食的研讨会。

examples.en: He studies electronics at the technical college.
examples.zh: 他在技术学院学习电子学。

examples.en: We walked through a dense forest of tall trees.
examples.zh: 我们穿过一片高树密布的茂密森林。

examples.en: She is very articulate when she speaks in public.
examples.zh: 她在公开演讲时口齿非常清晰。

examples.en: It was a bright and sunny day at the park.
examples.zh: 公园里是一个明媚阳光的好天气。

examples.en: The big swell rocked the small fishing boat.
examples.zh: 巨浪摇晃着那艘小渔船。

examples.en: Warm water will soften the hard bread.
examples.zh: 温水能让硬面包变软。

examples.en: He denied the accusation of stealing the money.
examples.zh: 他否认了偷钱的指控。

examples.en: The bride wore a beautiful white dress.
examples.zh: 新娘穿着一件漂亮的白色礼服。

examples.en: I am terribly sorry for being so late.
examples.zh: 我非常抱歉来得这么晚。

examples.en: Wait for the cue before you start singing.
examples.zh: 等到提示出现再开始唱歌。

examples.en: I am reading a biography of a famous scientist.
examples.zh: 我正在读一本著名科学家的传记。

examples.en: Wet floors are a hazard for old people.
examples.zh: 湿滑的地板对老年人来说是个危险。

examples.en: Please straighten the picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 请把墙上的画弄正。

examples.en: He seldom eats out because he likes cooking at home.
examples.zh: 他很少外出吃饭，因为他喜欢在家做饭。

examples.en: They put new white tiles on the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 他们在厨房地板上铺了新的白瓷砖。

examples.en: Honestly, I don't know the answer to that question.
examples.zh: 说实话，我不知道那个问题的答案。

examples.en: We must use our water more economically this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天我们必须更节约地用水。

examples.en: His answer was so vague that nobody understood it.
examples.zh: 他的回答含糊不清，没人能听懂。

examples.en: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚气温降到了零度以下。

examples.en: As a foreigner, he found the new language difficult.
examples.zh: 作为一个外国人，他觉得这门新语言很难。

examples.en: She came in twentieth place in the running race.
examples.zh: 她在赛跑中获得了第二十名。

examples.en: The children laughed with delight at the show.
examples.zh: 孩子们看着表演高兴地笑了。

examples.en: Please call me back at your convenience.
examples.zh: 请在你方便的时候给我回电话。

examples.en: The cloth has a tight and beautiful weave.
examples.zh: 这块布有着紧密而漂亮的织法。

examples.en: The mother made a desperate plea for help.
examples.zh: 那位母亲发出绝望的求助。

examples.en: He studied painting at a famous art academy.
examples.zh: 他在一所著名的艺术学院学习绘画。

examples.en: We need a sustainable way to use our energy.
examples.zh: 我们需要一种可持续的能源使用方式。

examples.en: The old house was built with strong timber.
examples.zh: 这座老房子是用坚固的木料建造的。

examples.en: Please wait here till I come back.
examples.zh: 请在这里等到我回来。

examples.en: She measured the room accurately before buying the carpet.
examples.zh: 她在买地毯前精确地测量了房间。

examples.en: He tightened the bolt to fix the metal door.
examples.zh: 他拧紧螺钉来固定金属门。

examples.en: The light bulb in the hall is broken.
examples.zh: 走廊里的灯泡坏了。

examples.en: She is a skilled cook who makes wonderful meals.
examples.zh: 她是一位手艺娴熟的厨师，能做出美味的饭菜。

examples.en: A cactus has sharp spines on its surface.
examples.zh: 仙人掌表面长着尖锐的刺。

examples.en: The ship carried a heavy cargo of grain.
examples.zh: 这艘船运载着大量谷物货物。

examples.en: In the story, the devil tries to trick the hero.
examples.zh: 在故事里，魔鬼试图欺骗英雄。

examples.en: The narrator told the story in a calm voice.
examples.zh: 讲述者用平静的声音讲着这个故事。

examples.en: The seller offered me a good price for the bike.
examples.zh: 卖家给了我一个不错的自行车价格。

examples.en: The missionary traveled far to teach in the village.
examples.zh: 这位传教士远道而来在村里传教。

examples.en: The boat slowly came up to the dock.
examples.zh: 小船慢慢地驶向码头。

examples.en: Thick fog made it hard to see the road.
examples.zh: 浓雾使人很难看清道路。

examples.en: Let's meet for coffee sometime next week.
examples.zh: 我们下周找个时间一起喝杯咖啡吧。

examples.en: The young marine was proud to serve his country.
examples.zh: 这名年轻的海军陆战队员为效力祖国而自豪。

examples.en: She wrote a short summary of the long report.
examples.zh: 她为那份长报告写了一份简短的摘要。

examples.en: The diplomat worked to keep peace between the two nations.
examples.zh: 这位外交官努力维护两国之间的和平。

examples.en: The flu epidemic spread quickly through the school.
examples.zh: 流感在学校里迅速蔓延开来。

examples.en: The garden looks neat and in good trim.
examples.zh: 花园看起来整洁又井井有条。

examples.en: The car accident was sadly fatal.
examples.zh: 那场车祸不幸导致了死亡。

examples.en: The boxes are stored in a large warehouse.
examples.zh: 这些箱子存放在一个大仓库里。

examples.en: A colorful butterfly landed on the flower.
examples.zh: 一只彩色的蝴蝶落在花上。

examples.en: There is an inherent danger in climbing high mountains.
examples.zh: 攀登高山有一种与生俱来的危险。

examples.en: The driver began to accelerate on the open road.
examples.zh: 司机在开阔的公路上开始加速。

examples.en: The old statue was made of shining bronze.
examples.zh: 这座古老的雕像是用闪亮的青铜制成的。

examples.en: The lifeguard saved the boy from drowning.
examples.zh: 救生员把那个男孩从溺水中救了出来。

examples.en: The company started a nationwide sale this week.
examples.zh: 本周这家公司开展了全国性的促销活动。

examples.en: There is no air in a vacuum.
examples.zh: 真空中没有空气。

examples.en: The children played in the cool water of the creek.
examples.zh: 孩子们在小溪清凉的水里玩耍。
